# ds_alpha__val Summary

The harness shows severe training-eval misalignment (29.76% train accuracy vs 56.25% eval), indicating the learning mechanism fails to internalize training examples. Reasoning remains consistently superficial ("Closest demonstrations suggest...") across all predictions, revealing that the model treats every query identically without adapting to learned patterns. The steadily growing memory context (12K+ chars) during learning does not translate into improved accuracy, suggesting the context accumulation mechanism stores rather than utilizes learned information. Recurring failures appear driven by simplistic demonstration similarity matching rather than class-specific feature extraction. To improve, the harness needs either a more effective in-context learning strategy that actually conditions predictions on training data, or a fundamentally different approach to selecting and weighting demonstrations.
